message: WEMBLEY PARK STATION: From Monday 10 March until Autumn 2026, no lift service between the street (Wembley Way / car park) and ticket hall. Step-free access is still available by using the entrance/exit on Bridge Road which is level between street and ticket hall. Lifts remain available to all platforms.

EARL'S COURT STATION: Until the end of service on Thursday 5 November, there will be no step-free access to/from the westbound District line. If you are starting a westbound step-free journey at Earl's Court, take an eastbound District line train to Victoria and change there for a westbound train. To complete a westbound step-free journey at Earl's Court, take an Ealing Broadway or Richmond train to Hammersmith and change there for an eastbound train back to Earl's Court.
King George V: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

West Brompton: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the eastbound District line and southbound Mildmay line / Southern platform due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 for more help
Bond Street: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the Central line due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

ELEPHANT & CASTLE UNDERGROUND STATION: Until late October, the lifts at the Northern line entrance are out of service for repairs. Please exit and enter the station via the Bakerloo line entrance in London Road.
Hampstead Heath: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the eastbound platform due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

Canonbury: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to platforms 2 & 3. For destinations via Canada Water take a train from platform 1 and change at Highbury & Islington. For destinations via Willesden Jn take a train from platform 3
Abbey Wood: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the Southeastern/Thameslink platforms due to a faulty lift. Call 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

Crystal Palace: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to platforms 5 and 6 towards Highbury & Islington and London Bridge (via Forest Hill) due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need further help.
Deptford Bridge: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available for trains towards Canary Wharf due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

Harold Wood: No Step Free Access - The lift to platform 4 (towards Shenfield) is out of service due to a fault. For step free access to platform 4, enter via the car park. For step free access to other platforms, use the entrance on Gibbons Lane.
Canary Wharf: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the Jubilee line due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

Acton Main Line: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the westbound platform (towards Hayes & Harlington) due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.
Willesden Junction: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the Bakerloo line and the Lioness line due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need more information.

Wembley Central: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available to the northbound Southern / London Northwestern platform due to a faulty lift. Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

CANADA WATER STATION: Until Spring 2027, no step-free access between street and ticket hall level at this station. This is while we carry out lift replacement work. For step-free access to the Jubilee line, take bus 47 or 188 from stop B1 in the bus station to Bermondsey. For step-free access to the Windrush line, take any bus from stop B2, or bus 1 or 381 from stop C in the bus station to Surrey Quays. Alternatively, it is about an 800m journey to Surrey Quays at street level via Deal Porters Way. You will not be able to use the lift between the street and ticket hall to enter the station. Please plan ahead and allow more time for your journey
